## What changes for the reader?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a new scene, state the question and the visual evidence that answers it.

## Evidence

List the checks actually run and any limits. For visual changes, include desktop/phone key frames and a preview URL if available. For narration changes, include observations from complete playback in both languages.

## Relevant checklist

- [ ] Scientific claims, model boundaries and sources agree.
- [ ] Chinese and English content and any affected recordings are consistent.
- [ ] The change is understandable while silent; optional controls have a clear purpose.
- [ ] Appropriate checks pass, and untested cases are explicitly recorded.
- [ ] New external assets have their license and provenance documented.

Mark unrelated items as not applicable in the description. A documentation typo does not require a scene review.
